description: This file contains utility functions and types for managing routed users, hosts, and team member matching logic within a scheduling or routing system, including delegation credentials enrichment and segment-based host filtering.

methods.name: getRoutedUsersWithContactOwnerAndFixedUsers
methods.description: Filters users based on routed team member IDs, fixed status, or contact owner email.

methods.name: findMatchingTeamMembersIdsForEventRRSegment
methods.description: Dynamically imports and finds team members matching attribute logic based on event type segmentation settings.

methods.name: getNormalizedHosts
methods.description: Normalizes host data or fallback user data into a consistent format for scheduling.

methods.name: getNormalizedHostsWithDelegationCredentials
methods.description: Enriches hosts with delegation credentials, or provides fallback hosts with credentials, based on event type.

methods.name: findMatchingHostsWithEventSegment
methods.description: Filters hosts based on segment matching with team members for event routing.
